summary.text: One of the earthborn Giants whom Hermes slew in the Gigantomachy, wearing the helmet of Hades.

story.text: Apollodorus names Hippolytus among the Giants destroyed when the gods fought with Heracles' aid: Hermes, wearing the helmet of Hades, slew Hippolytus in the fight. The revolt of the earthborn belongs to the Giants together; Hippolytus is one of those named in Apollodorus' battle roll.
This Hippolytus is not the son of Theseus whom Artemis rescued and whom Poseidon destroyed with a sea-bull.
